verdict: CAD repairs completed; factory acceptance and electrical qualification remain open. Full turnkey not confirmed.

issues.Finding: Native construction and winding resistance now use JLC081622-1080: 1.655 mm, 70 µm outer / 61 µm inner copper. The dielectric sum is 1.149 mm; the previous audit arithmetic was corrected.
issues.Required_closure: Factory must accept the exact construction, minimum finished copper, material and thickness tolerance. Characterize the physical transformer.

issues.Finding: Separated the LDO output and bypass lands; corrected U5 to TI DBV0005A land dimensions and rerouted the supply. Purchased-component copper no longer overlaps.
issues.Required_closure: Review the final factory placement overlay and solder joints.

issues.Finding: Rebuilt U1 from TI RAR0017B with a centered origin, zero-stroke custom copper and independent mask/paste. Power-pad paste coverage measures approximately 75–76%; mask openings remain inside their copper. Fine-pitch pad gaps exceed 0.20 mm.
issues.Required_closure: Approve 2 oz mask registration and the manufacturer 0.125 mm stencil example, paste transfer, fill/cap planarity and X-ray criteria.

issues.Finding: Rebuilt undersized courtyards to include solder lands/body envelopes plus an assembly allowance. Repositioned the controller, receiver dividers, bias and feedback parts. No purchased pad lies outside its courtyard; no courtyard overlaps.
issues.Required_closure: Factory spacing/placement review still applies to the actual package models and process.

issues.Finding: U1 now uses the manufacturer package center. Added visible top-side orientation marks to polarized U/D/Q packages and regenerated all 75 placement coordinates and 208 numbered pad anchors.
issues.Required_closure: Approve the supplier part-model overlay for every exact code; raw KiCad angles are not a universal JLC rotation correction.

issues.Finding: Added a 92 × 76 mm one-up frame with 7 mm rails, four top/bottom tabs, 0.5 mm mouse bites, three tooling holes and three panel fiducials. Connector sides remain untabbed. Connector pours use 0.6 mm thermal spokes without direct trace bypasses.
issues.Required_closure: Approve depanelization, overhanging headers, finished lead protrusion, solder fixture and insertion process. Use panel CPL only with panel Gerbers.

issues.Finding: Exact core-half, clip and removable-plug purchases remain specified. They are separately sourced mechanical/accessory items, not SMT placements.
issues.Required_closure: Obtain explicit JLC sourcing/consignment and post-solder fitting acceptance and a price. Otherwise delivery is electronics PCBA plus separate mechanical parts.

issues.Finding: A coordinate-level drill map marks 215 small interconnects for resin fill/copper cap, including six transformer transitions. Four connector and four mounting holes stay open. Panel mouse bites/tooling also stay open.
issues.Required_closure: Supplier must confirm the process for the listed 0.30 mm holes, not just objects named vias. Review hidden-joint X-ray and solder acceptance.

issues.Finding: All visible board legend meets the checked 1.0 mm text-height / 0.15 mm stroke guidance. Connector polarity is outside the housing footprint.
issues.Required_closure: Inspect the final silkscreen CAM preview.

issues.Finding: 43 exact electronic catalog codes cover all 75 placements. The 10 October snapshot supports five fitted boards before attrition; no electronic substitutions were made.
issues.Required_closure: Refresh stock, order-specific MOQ/attrition and warehouse allocation before release. Snapshot stock is not reserved.

issues.Finding: The updated nominal 80 °C winding DC-loss screen is 3.869 W before AC copper/core loss. Magnetics, effective capacitor capacitance/ripple, surge margin and frequency-dependent fault protection remain unqualified.
issues.Required_closure: Controlled bring-up, transformer characterization, surge/fault, regulation, ZVS/SR timing and thermal testing must close the electrical findings. No rated-power release is claimed.

issues.Finding: The selected stack is included in the nominal fit model. The board outline, original mounting-footprint geometry and 55 × 47 mm mounting pattern are preserved. Core slots retain 0.5 mm internal corner radii.
issues.Required_closure: Verify actual routed corners, core tolerances, gap orientation, clips and underside clearance using physical parts; nominal renders do not establish fit.
